review.headline: Tempo held on target: 5 km at 4:36/km against a 4:37/km prescription, with easy warm-up and cool-down.
observations: Tempo lap averaged 4:36/km, 1 s/km inside the 4:37 target, with the five tempo km splits steady at 4:36.
Warm-up and cool-down ran 5:45/km at HR 136-140, inside the easy zone (5:11-6:13/km).
Tempo HR averaged 163 (max 166), and aerobic efficiency of 1.304 matches the 2026-11-03 tempo, a strong sign of controlled execution.
Compared with the 2026-11-10 tempo (cut at 6 km, RPE 8, HR 163 at 5:37/km), this session shows much better pacing discipline.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so the subjective effort read is missing.
TSB is -4.3 and ATL (55.5) sits above CTL (47.2) after two long-ish efforts, so fatigue is building into the next block.
No runs have been logged since 2026-11-17, and CTL has fallen to 38.9, so the fitness trend is down.
